snippet.description:
What does a structured day of UPSC Prelims preparation actually look like? How do you balance classroom learning, PYQ practice, revision and regular tests without losing track of your preparation?

In this video, get a glimpse of the daily study routine planned for students of the Prelims Master Program (PMP) 2027.

From December to February, PMP follows a structured Monday-to-Saturday schedule designed to help you stay consistent and complete your preparation systematically.

A typical day at PMP 2027 includes:

- Around 4 Hours of Classes: Learn concepts and understand topics through classroom sessions.
- PYQ Practice: Attempt Previous Year Questions and understand how UPSC tests different topics.
- Around 4 Hours of Self-Study: Revise the notes and concepts covered in class.
- Daily 50-Question Tests: Test your understanding of the previous day's learning.
- Weekly Revision Tests: Revisit the topics covered throughout the week.
- Dedicated CSAT Practice: Allocate time to mathematics and other CSAT preparation requirements.

The idea is simple: attend classes, practise questions, revise what you learn and test yourself regularly.

PMP 2027 is designed to bring structure, consistency and accountability to your UPSC Prelims preparation.

Prelims can be tough and unpredictable. Your preparation shouldn't be.

#PMP2027 #upscprelims2027  #upscpreparation  #upscstudyplan  #upscprelimsstrategy  #levelupias
